title: Horned Goddess on Treasure Mound
description: A pale, horned female figure with elaborate headpiece and gold jewelry sits atop a large, dark, smoking pile of treasure and coins. In the smoky background, a large dark silhouette of a similar horned entity with outstretched arms is visible among glowing orbs.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene of a pale horned female deity wearing an elaborate horned headdress and golden jewelry, sitting atop a large black mound of treasure, coins and artifacts with smoke rising from it, her hand extended with magical sparks, in the background a large ominous black silhouette of a similar horned figure with multiple arms glowing with orbs and candles in a smoky atmosphere, detailed ink and digital painting style
